raw_comment:
What do you notice?
The graph shows areas in the United States impacted by drought. The middle of the US has been impacted the most, as it has most areas with exceptional, extreme, and severe widespread drought. Towards the east and west coasts, drought is still present, but it is less intense than in the center of the US. Almost all of the US has been affected by the drought to some extent, not including Florida, Alaska, and some small areas of the nation.

What do you wonder?
What is the cause of the drought? Why is the center of the US more impacted by the drought than the coasts? Why are Alaska and Florida the only states not affected by the drought?

How does this relate to you and your community?
This relates to me and my community because I live in the United States. My state, Michigan, is one of the states that has been affected by drought in the moderate and severe categories. If drought continues to impact the US, it could have a significant impact on the ecosystem of my area and the rest of the country.

Create a catchy headline that captures the graph’s main idea.
“Widespread Throughout: the Impact of US Drought”
